product_results.description: Our shampoos are concentrated, which means a little bit goes a long way! Be sure to thoroughly rinse your dog after shampooing to leave no residual shampoo behind. In addition, it’s important to always comb out and dry your pet's coat; leaving your dog with damp fur for hours can lead to potentional risk for dogs with sensitive skin. Wahl’s Oatmeal formula shampoo contains a coconut lime verbena scent the keeps your pet smelling great! Our shampoo helps gently cleanse, moisturize, & protect your puppy’s delicate skin by providing itch relief. The rich lather helps clean dirty coats and other environmental residue. Since our shampoo easily cleans, it leaves your dog’s coat looking clean, silky, and smooth. Our plant derived ingredients make our shampoo the choice for owners who want to avoid harsh chemicals for their dog and themselves. Our shampoo is PEG-80 free, alcohol free, paraben free, and pH balanced. Our 24 oz size and concentrated formula allows for up to 70% more baths than other leading brands. While there are no harmful chemicals in our pet products, some pets are sensitive to certain plant oils used in our products. Wahl strongly recommends talking to your vet and doing a small spot test on your pet at least 24 hours before using any new product. Wahl has been serving professional vets and groomers for over 50 years. As a company of animal lovers, we believe your pet deserves the very best.

authors_reviews.title: Works great on both our long-haired and short-haired dogs
authors_reviews.text: We've been using this shampoo for quite a while, and it's become our go-to for both of our dogs. We have one long-haired dog and one short-haired dog, and it works equally well on both. It lathers nicely, rinses out easily, and leaves both coats soft, clean, and shiny.The coconut lime scent is fresh and pleasant without being overpowering, and they both smell great for several days after a bath. A little shampoo goes a long way, so the bottle lasts longer than I expected.Even though this shampoo is marketed for dry skin and itch relief, we've simply found it to be an excellent everyday dog shampoo. It gets them clean, leaves their coats feeling healthy, and we've had no issues using it regularly.Overall, it's a high-quality shampoo at a fair price. It's worked great for both of our dogs despite their very different coats, and we'll definitely keep buying it.
authors_reviews.author: Matt

authors_reviews.title: Absolutely Love This Shampoo!
authors_reviews.text: I’ve tried quite a few dog shampoos over the years, and this is by far one of my favorites. It lathers really well, so a little goes a long way, and it rinses out easily without leaving any residue.My dog’s coat feels incredibly soft after every bath, and the oatmeal formula really helps with dry, itchy skin. I also love that it’s pH-balanced, pet-friendly, and free of parabens and alcohol, so I don’t have to worry about using it on sensitive skin.The Coconut Lime Verbena scent is clean and fresh without being overpowering, and it leaves my dog smelling amazing for days.The large 64 oz bottle is an excellent value, especially if you bathe your dog regularly or have multiple pets.I highly recommend this shampoo to anyone looking for a high-quality product that leaves their pet clean, soft, moisturized, and smelling fantastic. I’ll definitely be buying it again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

authors_reviews.title: Gentle Soothing Shampoo That Leaves Coat Soft And Fresh
authors_reviews.text: This Wahl Dry Skin and Itch Relief Pet Shampoo has been a fantastic addition to our pet care routine. The oatmeal formula is very gentle and soothing, especially for pets with dry or itchy skin. After just one bath, I noticed my pet seemed more comfortable, with less scratching and irritation.The concentrated formula creates a rich lather with only a small amount of product. It spreads easily through the coat and rinses out without leaving any residue behind. I really appreciate that a little goes a long way, especially with the large 64 ounce bottle, which makes it a great value for long term use.The coconut lime verbena scent is another highlight. It smells fresh and clean without being too strong, and the scent lasts for days after bathing. My pet’s coat looked noticeably softer, shinier, and healthier after using this shampoo.I also like that the formula is pH balanced and free from alcohol, parabens, and harsh ingredients. Knowing that it is designed to be gentle and allergy friendly gives extra peace of mind, especially for pets with sensitive skin.Overall, this shampoo delivers excellent results with soothing moisture, long lasting freshness, and a soft shiny coat. A reliable and high quality choice for keeping pets clean, comfortable, and happy.
